description: This file contains React components and logic for managing multi-factor authentication (MFA) setup steps in the Notesnook project, including UI for selecting MFA methods, setting up authenticators, displaying recovery codes, and confirming MFA enablement.

methods.name: ChooseAuthenticator
methods.description: Component for selecting MFA method (app, sms, email).

methods.name: AuthenticatorSelector
methods.description: Component for setting up selected MFA method, including QR code for app, email, or SMS setup.

methods.name: SetupAuthenticatorApp
methods.description: Component for configuring authenticator app, displaying QR code and shared key.

methods.name: SetupEmail
methods.description: Component for setting up email MFA, including sending verification code.

methods.name: SetupSMS
methods.description: Component for setting up SMS MFA, including phone number validation and code sending.

methods.name: BackupRecoveryCodes
methods.description: Component for displaying, printing, copying, and downloading MFA recovery codes.

methods.name: TwoFactorEnabled
methods.description: Component indicating MFA has been enabled, with option to set up fallback.

methods.name: Fallback2FAEnabled
methods.description: Component indicating fallback MFA method has been enabled.

methods.name: VerifyAuthenticatorForm
methods.description: Form component for entering MFA verification code.

methods.name: mfaMethodToPhrase
methods.description: Converts MFA method type to human-readable phrase.
